title: Gift Contagion in Online Groups: Evidence from Virtual Red Packets
eligible_reason: No difference-in-differences design. Natural experiment from random allocation of red packet amounts; stratified randomized-experiment analysis with stratum fixed effects.
design_notes: 36 million red packets on a large social platform (Tencent); recipient response within 10 minutes and 24 hours regressed on amount received with stratum FE. Continuous treatment, no staggered adoption.
screener_notes: Text-only screen. No package_dir. Platform data (Tencent), anonymized, likely proprietary.
